'''T'pala paste''' was a substance with medicinal properties.

==Description==
T'pala paste was produced by mixing [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] with [[chuba fungus]]. It could be used to heal wounds or to treat poisons or disease.

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] healer [[Lumia'Silbossa]] used t'pala paste to treat injured people in [[The Enclave]], in the place of [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], which were difficult for them to obtain.
